label: VexLife Local VoiceInput
purpose: Make VoiceInput a dependable browser-independent local VexLife capability by preserving the current VoiceInput Family/UI/Composer path, moving speech-to-text realization from browser Web Speech to a VexLife-owned local ASR provider/runtime, and proving local audio custody, usable transcription, security/privacy boundaries, Stop/recovery behavior, and lived operation across representative browsers without per-browser semantic implementations.
